correctness.rationale: The exact standalone verifier constructs all thirty vertices and distances and exhaustively enumerates 1,022 and 15,966 faces; directed Hasse DAG checks certify 510 and 7,981 acyclic Morse pairs. It verifies critical cells (0,2) and (0,2,2,3), exact signed Morse differential (1,-1), a 56-triangle closed surface cycle, cocycle conditions against all 330 and 3,150 tetrahedron boundaries and evaluations +1/-1, fifteen farthest antipodal pairs, and all inclusion consequences. The r1 stage is checked with all 20 triangles and disjoint free edges. Standard integral discrete Morse and CW attachment topology prove the claimed homotopy and persistence; this is not extrapolated from samples.

value.rationale: This is a complete homotopy-and-persistence classification of the canonical thirty-vertex rectified icosahedron, a proposed Archimedean extension of Platonic-solid Rips research. Its integral persistence class survives the nontrivial radius-two to radius-three inclusion, although the latter stage contains 15,966 simplices reaching dimension nine; this contrasts with the null inclusion phenomenon in Hamming-cube Rips complexes. The natural graph, parameter-free full range of scales, and exact homotopy equivalence give geometric and persistent-topology significance beyond an isolated rank computation.
